title: WaterSound "You are my Sunshine" 261 Salt Box Lane
h1: WaterSound "You are my Sunshine" 261 Salt Box Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- 2-5 blocks from the beach in charming WaterSound neighborhood- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Ample indoor/outdoor space with an awesome screened porch- YouTube TV- Free WiFi- 4-passenger golf cart- 3 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 2 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: 261 Salt Box Lane is a coastal-style home in a charming neighborhood, making this an unforgettable vacation location! This renovated 3-bedroom, 4-bath home in WaterSound is sure to satisfy. With its inviting rooms and tranquil surroundings, this will be your perfect vacation retreat. The home also includes a golf cart, which is perfect for getting to and from the beach! When entering the home, you will be welcomed by the incredible great room and brand new furniture. You will also be able to enjoy meals prepared in its remarkable kitchen with high-end appliances, granite countertops, stunning cabinetry, and an impressive breakfast bar. This kitchen has all of the items needed to prepare that wonderful meal! The relaxing living room, well-appointed dining room, and fabulous kitchen are all included in this open floor plan for everyone to enjoy after a fun-filled day at the beach. What a perfect end to a perfect day!On the first floor, you will encounter a light and airy bedroom with a king-size bed, complete with a connecting bathroom with a single vanity and walk-in shower. You will also find a bright and comfortable bedroom with a King-size bed on this floor with a connecting bathroom with a single vanity and tub and walk-in shower. The bathrooms have been completely renovated with new paint, hardware, and countertops. On the second floor, there is an amazing bedroom with an XL twin-over-twin bunk bed and king bed, balcony access, a flat-screen TV, and an attached bathroom with single vanity, clawfoot tub, and walk-in shower. This will definitely give you that vacation retreat you were looking for! This house has ample indoor and outdoor space. The awesome screened porch is truly a great gathering spot for everyone to spend time together, making a memorable vacation! This gorgeous WaterSound home is simply stunning and gives you the serenity you have been craving, and it is all here at one of the most beautiful beaches in the world!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 8)FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: XL Twin-over-XL Twin Bunk Bed and King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower And Tub*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and management fines.
